Carrying Apple devices when traveling usually means bringing a whole pile of charging cables and wall adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank is designed to solve this problem, integrating everything you need into one compact charger. It has a built-in folding wall plug, a detachable USB-C cable, and a magnetic Apple Watch charger. It's exactly the kind of accessory I love to bring when traveling, whether for on-the-go charging or overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of wireless charging for your Apple devices.

Built for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has built-in folding wall plug prongs on the back, so you can recharge the power bank without bringing a separate wall adapter—just plug it straight into a hotel or vacation rental outlet. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I absolutely love this design!), so you can charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more without packing extra cables.

Although I usually focus on iPhone MagSafe here, this power bank features a dedicated 5-watt magnetic charging module specifically for Apple Watch. When your watch is running low on battery, just place it on the power bank and you're sorted—the magnets hold it firmly in place, and there's no need to bring the original charger. It's incredibly convenient.

With a 10,000 mAh capacity, this power bank is more than enough to keep both your iPhone and Apple Watch topped up during long trips. For me, the most practical feature is its 40-watt USB-C output, which in an emergency (with the MacBook Air lid closed) is genuinely enough to keep your laptop going.

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you're looking to pack a lighter travel bag for your Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. Wall plug, Apple Watch charger, and USB-C cable in one, with a sleek design that fits easily into a handbag or pocket.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from the RORRY website or Amazon.
